tool_model_variant: Not exposed by built-in tool; no CLI/API fallback used.
generation_policy: One isolated pose per call. Original identity referenced every call; directional idle also referenced for animation. Selected raw PNGs copied byte-for-byte from built-in output; no resizing, matte operation, recoloring or pixel reconstruction by this worker.

prompt_source_method.reused: Original identity plus directional/previous accepted frame, narrow pose edits and visual rejection of limb failures, as documented in repository RESEARCH.md.
prompt_source_method.evidence_limit: Original workflow was documented by prior repository audit. Direct re-open this turn returned non-retryable safe-open error; no retry or new verification claimed.

pivot_note: Requested common ground anchor, not extracted engine-ready pivot. Keep common original/head scale; review fixed-canvas registration and floor contact after matte extraction. Do not independently stretch poses to match bbox height.
bounds_method: Estimated warm foreground bounds from original RGB: R-B>12 and max(R,G,B)-min(R,G,B)>14; x1/y1 exclusive. This detects colored body against painted neutral checker. These are NOT alpha bounds and may omit dark outline pixels.
hand_method: Approximate anatomical LEFT wrist centers manually inspected in raw1254square source, normalized x/width,y/height. These are review guides, not final PixelRespecter/runtime grips.
alpha_review: All five outputs RGB without alpha. Opaque checker is a known rejected delivery property. Source pose approval does not approve direct runtime use.
recovery: Use idle.png as the third attack/recovery pose; no additional recovery generated.

validation_scope: All selected full-resolution outputs visually inspected. PNG size/mode/hash and warm-body bounds measured using Pillow/Numpy without modifying images. No runtime import, animation playback, equipment composite or final gameplay-size visual acceptance performed.
